blocks.name: careful
blocks.oldLua:
quest:StartMovieSequence()
            quest:PauseAllNonScriptedEntities(true)
            fVar19 = controlled_health()
            fVar20 = 0.0
            if not (fVar19 > fVar20) then
                -- LAB_00db6088: (native jump target)
                quest:PauseAllNonScriptedEntities(false)
                goto LAB_00db6933
            end
            bVar3 = false
            pCVar24 = 0x1
            pCVar23 = 0x0
            pCVar22 = 0x0
            pcVar21 = "TEXT_QST_048_BARRELMAN_CAREFUL"
            pCVar7 = quest:GetHero()
            r7 = resources:Speak(barrel_resource, pCVar7, pcVar21, pCVar22, (pCVar23 ~= 0), (pCVar24 ~= 0), bVar3)
            bVar3 = resources:IsPerformingScriptTask(barrel_resource)
            if bVar3 then
                repeat
                    alive = quest:NewScriptFrame(me)
                    alive = not quest:IsActiveThreadTerminating()
                    if not alive then
                        quest:PauseAllNonScriptedEntities(false)
                        goto LAB_00db6af8
                    end
                    bVar3 = resources:IsPerformingScriptTask(barrel_resource)
                until not (bVar3)
            end
            alive = not quest:IsActiveThreadTerminating()
            if alive then return end  -- TODO(native): goto LAB_00db6088
            quest:PauseAllNonScriptedEntities(false)
            goto LAB_00db6af8
